title: Meri beti meri sakina jaan
body:
meri beti meri sakina jaan
maa yeh roro ke kar rahi thi bayan
tere rone se zindagi thi yahan
kaisa veeran hogaya yeh makan
1. asr-e-ashoor aur woh sham-e-alam
kaisey bhooloongi main woh zulm-o-sitam
hain nigaho mein aaj tak wo samaa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. dasht-e-ghurbat se mulk e shaam talak
har sitam dekhti thi chashmein falak
zindagi thi asir-e-tauq-e-gara
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ab yeh aankon ka kaam rona hai
subha rona hai shaam rone hai
bas teri yaad tere gham mein fugha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. baad tere yeh zindagi kya hain
yeh andhera yeh roshini kya hain
kis se rudad-e-gham karoo main bayan
<<DIVIDER>>
5. ab watan jaake kya karoon bibi
koi pooche to kya kahoon bibi
rah mushkil hai yeh nahi aasan
<<DIVIDER>>
6. tera matam hai aur zikr tera
tere gham mein hai sab yeh aaho bukaa
yeh aza khana bangaya zinda
<<DIVIDER>>
7. gham yehruk jaaye yeh nahi mumkin
kitni sadiya guzar gayi lekin
hai fareed aaj bhi yeh maa ki fuga
